new_results.name: QFORM-CONVEX-TV-EXTREME-LOCALIZATION-v1
new_results.statement: For any convex TV-lower-semicontinuous functional of a pushforward of fixed-mass cap-one product laws, the exact supremum equals the supremum over product marginals 1_E with E a bounded finite union of intervals of the same mass. No common diameter, fragment-count, separation, translation or moment parameter occurs.

new_results.name: QFORM-CONDITIONAL-LP-BUDGET-EXTREME-LOCALIZATION-v1
new_results.statement: For p>1, the integrated conditional Lp density budget on environment x output has exactly the same supremum over arbitrary cap-one core laws as over bounded finite-union extreme product core laws.

new_results.name: QFORM-FULL-LAW-CLASS-LOCALIZATION-COROLLARY
new_results.statement: The optimal full QFORM density constant over all arbitrary cap-one product laws equals the optimal constant restricted to bounded finite-union indicator marginals, including the value +infinity. Whole finite-union extreme sets must not be normalized componentwise.

partner_application.strict_target_corollary: If |c|>=1 and sqrt(d^2+||b||_2^2)>=1 then ||p_Q||inf <= 3*2^(7/6)=6.734772289856... and the coefficient matrix has at least three eigenvalues of modulus >=1.
partner_application.diffuse_case: d=0 and b=(1/sqrt(m),...,1/sqrt(m)) gives the same dimension-free bound although every physical receiver-driver entry tends to zero.
